scope: Offline analysis of existing plaza states only; no new game run, screenshots, desktop input or visual/audio verification.
method: Decompress native LZ4 state blocks with bounded private parser; verify exact declared output length and end of file.
Identify MEM1 by intersection of three 128-byte unchanged executable anchors.
Decode memory sizes before RAM; locate MEM2 using vendored MemoryManager::DoState layout.
Follow startup small-data base and dialog-manager accessor; cross-check manager vtable and option-construction method.
Compare the same dialog slot and its paired option/callback fields at start, short endpoint and long endpoint.
conclusion: The long endpoint contains a newly populated failure/retry dialog option group absent at baseline and at the short endpoint. This supports a failure/retry-path inference during the long run and disqualifies treating its late stable cadence as demonstrated continuous combat.
limitations: The populated slot is not the selected dialog index at either endpoint; this is historical/state evidence, not proof that the failure menu is currently displayed.
Does not timestamp the transition or attribute the 1220ms presentation gap.
Does not establish hero health, current enemy count or sustained combat, including for the short run.
Unmodified private game state, text, instructions and decompressed memory remain outside Git.
